description: Source code for the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 UploadedFile class implementing UploadedFileInterface, handling uploaded file streams, errors, and file movement.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Class representing an uploaded file, providing methods to access file info, move the file, and handle errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the uploaded file object with stream or filename, size, error status, and optional client info.

methods.name: setStreamOrFile
methods.description: Sets the internal stream or filename based on the input, validating the type.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Validates and sets the error status for the upload.

methods.name: isStringNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string parameter is non-empty.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Returns true if there is no upload error.

methods.name: isMoved
methods.description: Checks if the file has been moved.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Ensures the file is in a valid state for operations, throws exceptions if not.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream of the uploaded file, opening it if necessary.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a specified target path.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error status of the upload.
